text: Johanna Hashim, Senior Planner, and Christine Ono, Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, Policy and Analysis, City Planning, will give a presentation on Rental Replacement: Vulnerable Tenants Project. This presentation is in follow-up to an initial consultation with the Housing Rights Advisory Committee’s Maintaining Housing Working Group. An overview of a draft process and eligibility criteria which incorporates input from key stakeholders will be presented.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee received the item for information.
